visualLocks: Teen Titans original animated series2003–2006, not TeenTitansGo/live action/DCAMU/comic reboot.
Cool gray skin, short angular violet bob with central forehead part, small red diamond forehead gem, violet eyes and restrained expression.
Hooded long dark blue-violet cloak, round red clasp in gold ring; black long-sleeve leotard with blue-violet cuffs, gold chain belt with round red gems.
